sys_hub_flow.description: one reusable Subflow for every log row, success or failure Every Flow writes to Remote Sync Log in two places: on success (main line) and on failure (Error Handler). Instead of repeating a Create Record with eight fields eight times, build it once as a Subflow. Every Flow calls it; only the status and the values differ. Change the log once, and every Flow follows.
sys_hub_flow.name: Remote Sync: Write Log
